# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 23

**1** Jesus said: "I will pick you out — one from a thousand, two from ten thousand — and they will stand as one."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Pick you out" — "choose" rendered as active selection, singling out from the crowd
- The numbers are staggering: the chosen are fewer than one-tenth of one percent
- "Stand as one" — the *monachos* ideal; despite being multiple, they are unified

---
